question: pr2879
answer:
### What changed

- `Client`, `AsyncClient`, and the top-level request, streaming, and HTTP verb helpers now accept `proxy=` for a single proxy. Truthy `proxies=` values still work with a `DeprecationWarning`, and supplying both truthy arguments raises `RuntimeError`. [httpx/_client.py](httpx/_client.py) · [httpx/_api.py](httpx/_api.py)
- `HTTPTransport` and `AsyncHTTPTransport` now accept proxy strings and `URL` objects alongside `Proxy` objects. The docs switch to `mounts=` for per-route configuration, and mount annotations now allow `None` entries for bypasses. [httpx/_transports/default.py](httpx/_transports/default.py) · [httpx/_types.py](httpx/_types.py) · [docs/advanced.md](docs/advanced.md)

### Bugs and compatibility risks

- **`proxies={}` can now silently enable environment proxies.** Previously an empty mapping suppressed proxy discovery. Now `proxies or proxy` evaluates to `None` when `proxy` is omitted, so both clients and the top-level helpers can route requests through environment-configured proxies when `trust_env` allows it. The empty mapping also skips the deprecation warning. [httpx/_client.py](httpx/_client.py:674) · [httpx/_client.py](httpx/_client.py:1414)
- **CLI scripts using `--proxies` break immediately.** Click now accepts `--proxy` only. The changelog describes the Python keyword deprecation but omits the CLI break. [httpx/_main.py](httpx/_main.py:389) · [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)
- The compatibility guide contains an invalid exclusion example and incorrectly says top-level helpers accept `mounts=`. When migrating a proxy map to explicit transports, callers also need to carry over relevant TLS, HTTP version, and connection-limit settings. [docs/compatibility.md](docs/compatibility.md:168) · [httpx/_client.py](httpx/_client.py:695)

### Other affected surfaces

The public `httpx` re-exports expose the new signatures. Proxy tests cover warnings, SOCKS selection, conflicting arguments, and a sync mount. Contributing and troubleshooting examples also migrate. This was a static review. [httpx/__init__.py](httpx/__init__.py) · [tests/client/test_proxies.py](tests/client/test_proxies.py) · [docs/contributing.md](docs/contributing.md) · [docs/troubleshooting.md](docs/troubleshooting.md)
